name: depop
description: Hide stars, followers, and watchers on GitHub

scripts.deps: node --version && pnpm --version && mogrify --version && dprint --version && typos --version && rg --version && web-ext --version
scripts.check: dprint check && typos && biome check && tsc --noEmit && pnpm run check:manifest
scripts.selfup: git ls-files '.github' | xargs nix run github:kachick/selfup/v1.2.0 -- run
scripts.all: pnpm run setup && pnpm run deps && pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:firefox && pnpm run resize
